title: Interaction-Endowed PT-Symmetry and its Effects on Decoherence, Einselection, and Non-Markovianity in a Central Spin Model
summary: We have introduced PT-symmetry to a central spin model by adding a PT-symmetric interaction with a tunable hermiticity parameter $γ$. Using the pseudo-Hermitian formalism, we applied a Dyson map to transform the non-Hermitian Hamiltonian to its Hermitian representation. We have found that the decoherence slows down as $γ$ increases, eventually ceasing at $γ=1$. We define a pseudo-Hermitian observable that commutes with the metric operator to add as the self-Hamiltonian.
